note: v4.3 plan P3.8: the model lifecycle guard as dated data. A model may be used by a PAID call only when it is listed under 'active' with a vendor source URL and a 'checked' date at most 'max_check_age_days' old on the day of the run (core/model_lifecycle_guard.assert_fresh_for_paid_run). Names that came only from the v4.3 archive carry checked=null: they block nothing and allow no paid call until someone reads the vendor page and dates the entry.
